encoder_objective.fine_search: For every block, exhaust all 256 charged scale labels and select all 376 sign labels to minimize exact orthogonal-span SSE. Because every record is fixed at 384 bits, D+lambda*R reduces to exact D minimization inside this frozen conditional codebook.
encoder_objective.same_codebook_forced_local_comparator: sign(y) and the nearest frozen scale to mean(abs(y)); executable must report exact record mismatch count and require zero mismatches, proving local/exhaustive equivalence for this separable fixed-rate codebook.
encoder_objective.not_claimed: No LOGIC-Q architecture, entropy-variable label rate, joint coarse/fine codeword search, or change to v6 coarse labels.

hard_kill.exact_nested_required_capture: max(0,1-0.025/D0), where D0 is the independently decoded v6 coarse SSE divided by exact BF16 source energy
hard_kill.rule_1: If measured B[:,0:384] continuous capture is below the exact nested threshold, emit no finite composite and hard-reject this branch.
hard_kill.rule_2: If parent rank384 survives but implemented B[:,0:376] continuous capture is below threshold, emit no finite composite and hard-reject this implementation.
hard_kill.nonconverse: Failure kills only this fixed conditional dyadic finite codebook, not graph lifting, posterior reconstruction, syndrome coding, joint coarse/fine search, or broader TACTIC-CAGE.
